name: max-warm-watchdog
_comment: Layer-2 server-side self-down sidecar for entryPoint-OVERRIDE taskdefs (which bypass entrypoint-gpu.sh). Same watchdog as server/self_down.py: scales THIS service (+ASG) to 0 after IDLE_MINUTES of no vLLM activity OR MAX_WARM_HOURS, whichever first. This clean shape execs /app/self_down.py (requires the image to bake it, as server/Dockerfile.gpu does). The live devci taskdef runs the minimal gpu-stream image, which does NOT bake self_down.py, so its sidecar INLINES the identical logic from server/max-warm-sidecar-entrypoint.sh instead — keep the two in sync. Tune via IDLE_MINUTES / MAX_WARM_HOURS / IDLE_POLL_SEC env (0 disables that layer); needs the task role in server/self-down-iam.json.
